question: Shivaji assumed the title ‘Chatrapati’ in the year –
solution: The word Chatrapati is a Sanskrit term which was used by the Marathas as an equivalent to the title King or emperor. The word Chatrapati can be spilt into two halves namely Chatra (roof or umbrella) and Pati (master, owner or ruler), referring to the one who takes care of his subjects protecting them from above like an umbrella.
